contracts.publication: Guard owns Child settlement and commit_record; they are provisional pending observed completed publication+later integration-owned closeout and independent actual parent exit.

disposition_fields: identities covering ALL durable runner, child/helper launch and retained census identities
release.immutability: parent disposition binds exact bounded full tree census; runner binds prior-attempt census at admission and rechecks during ledger/commit/closeout under explicit exclusive-writer premise
release.liveness: PROC_ALL_PIDS includes zombies; missing PID plus empty recorded own group proves gone; known current different start proves PID reused; same start/zombie/ESRCH-but-listed/unknown original start present/unreadable/truncated census REFUSES. No timeout/retry loop, escalation or override for uncertain liveness.
release.parent_release_entry: {dir, launch_record_sha256|null, summary_sha256|null, closeout_sha256|null, disposition:{path,sha256}}; null only if corresponding file is absent; partial/malformed files must still be pinned exactly
release.partial_files: A new explicit parent failure disposition can retire a fully ended attempt with exact-pinned partial bytes; file absence or a parseable self-summary never releases resources.
release.special_cases: legacy/no-closeout needs legacy_audit or publication_failure_disposed; missing/partial/malformed publication, mismatched proposed-vs-actual exit needs publication_failure_disposed. Every readable known-owner record is still covered, even if runner launch is absent.

contracts.uncertainty_rule: Every uncertain owner/census/publication/resource retains full parent block. No ECHILD normalization, Popen poll/wait authority, unknown-start signalling, ESRCH-as-death or zombie settlement.
